event_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred (e.g. "2024-01-24T17:39:57+01:00"). If no value is passed, the timestamp of the event creation is used.

event_name.description: The name of the event that occurred. This is how you will find your event in Brevo. Limited to 255 characters; only alphanumeric characters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_) are allowed.

event_properties.description: Properties of the event. Top level properties and nested properties can be used to better segment contacts and personalise workflow conditions. Keys are limited to 255 characters, alphanumerical characters and - _ only. Size is limited to 50KB.
